confidence_notes: I made 5 web searches: one for the RBA rate and four for prices. Food and drink anchors rest on aggregated cost-of-living data for Koh Lanta. Numbeo (updated April 2025) gives roughly 80 THB for a domestic draft beer, 97 THB for a cappuccino, 102 THB for an inexpensive meal and 1,175 THB for a mid-range meal for two. A 2026 travel budget guide gives 80-120 THB for a restaurant Chang beer and 150-250 THB for a cocktail. I converted baht to USD at an assumed rate of about 32-33 THB per USD, which I did not look up. Older USD-denominated sources conflicted: Traveltables and Digital Nomads were lower, Wise higher. I set the inexpensive meal and mid-range meal above Numbeo to reflect tourist-restaurant pricing. I found no Koh Lanta price for wine by the glass. That anchor comes from 2026 Thai resort and island ranges of about 180-500 THB, adjusted down because Koh Lanta is cheaper than Phuket. The cocktail anchor uses the Koh Lanta 150-250 THB range, about twice the beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from searches or listings. They are the least certain anchors because Koh Lanta has few registered hostels and rates swing between the high season (roughly Nov-Apr) and the green season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Koh Lanta is a laid-back Andaman island with tourist-oriented but moderately priced restaurants, slightly cheaper than Phuket and Krabi's Ao Nang. Food and drink prices come from Koh Lanta aggregated data. Wine and accommodation are benchmarked against comparable Thai island and beach destinations such as Krabi and Koh Phangan.
